paper.title_en: Scalar-Induced Gravitational Waves Probing Phase Transitions in the Standard Model and Beyond
paper.abstract_en: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) are unique messengers of physics in the early Universe and possible sources for the observed data from pulsar timing arrays (PTAs). It has been demonstrated that SIGWs have the potential to probe cosmological phase transitions via measurement of the equation of state and sound speed of the cosmic thermal bath, which have non-trivial time dependence during phase transitions. In this work, we improve on existing studies of SIGWs in a time-dependent background with time-dependent initial conditions and an entropy-conserving thermal history of the Standard Model (SM). We provide possible physical explanations for features of the gravitational wave spectrum from phase transitions, the most prominent of which for a scale-invariant curvature spectrum is a step due to entropy dilution. We show that current and future gravitational wave observations across a wide range of frequencies can probe phase transitions in the SM and physics beyond the Standard Model (BSM). Signals from the QCD crossover appear around 10 nHz, inside the observable window of PTAs. We perform data analyses using NANOGrav 15-year data, showing a mild preference for the QCD crossover over standard radiation domination for two choices of curvature spectra. BSM phase transitions in the TeV range lead to signals around mHz, which are accessible in future space-based experiments such as LISA, Taiji and TianQin.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将标量诱导引力波与早期宇宙相变及脉冲星计时阵列观测（NANOGrav 15年数据）联系起来，并讨论LISA、太极、天琴等未来探测，主题与PTA方向直接相关，且理论框架与数据分析兼具，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 标量诱导引力波探测标准模型及超越标准模型中的相变
decision.abstract_zh: 标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）是早期宇宙物理的独特信使，也可能是脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）观测数据的可能来源。已有研究表明，SIGWs有潜力通过测量宇宙热浴的物态方程和声速来探测宇宙学相变，这些量在相变期间具有非平凡的时间依赖性。在本工作中，我们改进了关于时间依赖背景下SIGWs的现有研究，考虑时间依赖的初始条件以及标准模型（SM）的熵守恒热历史。我们为相变产生的引力波谱特征提供了可能的物理解释，其中对于标度不变的曲率谱，最显著的特征是由于熵稀释导致的一个台阶。我们表明，当前和未来的跨宽频段引力波观测可以探测SM及超越标准模型（BSM）物理中的相变。来自QCD交叉转变的信号出现在约10 nHz附近，位于PTAs的可观测窗口内。我们使用NANOGrav 15年数据进行数据分析，结果表明对于两种曲率谱选择，QCD交叉转变相较于标准辐射主导有轻微的偏好。TeV能区的BSM相变产生的信号在约mHz附近，可在LISA、太极和天琴等未来天基实验中被观测到。
